content: UEFA EURO - Balotelli sends Italy past Germany to EURO 2012 final - News. # Balotelli sends Italy past Germany to EURO 2012 final. Mario Balotelli struck twice as Italy once again proved Germany's nemesis, Cesare Prandelli's side holding on in Warsaw to set up a final against Spain. EURO 2012 highlights: Germany 1-2 Italy. Italy once again proved to be Germany's nemesis after Mario Balotelli struck two first-half goals to set up a UEFA EURO 2012 final against Spain on Sunday. Joachim Löw's side came into the semi-final full of confidence having swept all before them in Poland and Ukraine, but perhaps lingering at the back of their minds was the fact that Germany had never beaten the Azzurri in seven competitive meetings. Prandelli has described his side as a work in progress but, after surviving a nervous opening, they were soon looking like the finished article. Özil and Toni Kroos, on his first start of the tournament, tested Buffon again, but the Azzurri were looking the more dangerous side.
